findings.reason: The same English term 'Archived' is a state phrase here and the locale's established adjective 'آرکائیو شدہ' in ui.chat.sidebar.row.archived_suffix, ui.chat.sidebar.search.include_archived and the identical English key ui.projects.project_model.archived. findings.proposed: رن کی تفصیلات بند کریں / رن کی تفصیلات کھولیں
findings.reason: Both labels drop the 'run' qualifier that names the pane; the locale already uses 'رن' for the run concept in ui.chat.composer.tip.run_panel ('رن پینل'). Acceptable as-is if the pane is the only details surface; the 20-cell budget is advisory and the qualified form is 23 cells.

observations: Merged bytes are byte-identical to the branch parent d784571d90; the merge adds new_chat and new_chat_with on top of main's 10-key file. Key order equals English.

supersedes.why: The merged bytes no longer match the recorded pair; this receipt names the current bytes so ledger-assemble can move the old audit to superseded and bind the new one.

scope: All 12 keys at the merged bytes, read against the English source and the en context sidecar. The merged ur file is byte-identical to branch parent d784571d90 and adds new_chat and new_chat_with versus main.
method: Manual side-by-side read of every ur value against its en value and context; mechanical checks: key parity both directions and key order, ICU parse and normalised placeholder/select/plural/skeleton comparison with @formatjs, bidi-control and punctuation scan, byte hashes from git objects, and for the sidebar rendered outputs at counts 0/1/2/1000 with intl-messageformat. For the viewer, per-key union provenance against both merge parents.

icu.note: Normalised comparison: an en # inside a plural arm and an ur {arg, number, ::group-off} of that plural's own argument are the same value; the only such substitution is groups.badge. Executed with @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser 3.5.21; output recorded in this receipt.
